description: Console logs, network requests and user actions merged in time order, with times relative to recording start (+12.4s). Best view for reproducing a bug. Narrow with from_s/to_s around an error.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call.

from_s.description: Start, in seconds from recording start.

recording.description: Traceo share link (e.g. https://www.traceo.dev/abc123...) or recording id.

to_s.description: End, in seconds from recording start.

name: get_timeline
title: Get recording timeline
